name: rate-my-idea
description: Claude rates every request you make from 1 to 10 and says whether it would do it if the product were its own. Honest product judgment next to the work, not just compliance.

hooks.command: [ "$RATE_MY_IDEA" = off ] && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"rate-my-idea is on: if this message asks you to do, build, change or decide something, add one line to your reply (top or bottom): Rating N/10, whether you would do it if the product were yours, and the one-line reason. Be honest, disagree when you would, then still do the task unless it is unsafe. Skip it for plain questions and small talk."}}'
